rules.sentence: Pulmonary hypertension can be suspected on clinical presentation.

If pulmonary hypertension is suspected, a presumptive diagnosis of pulmonary hypertension can be made with echocardiography, which estimates the systolic pressure of the pulmonary artery and right heart function.
Further tests are done to exclude heart and lung diseases that are the common causes of pulmonary hypertension.
ECG shows right ventricular hypertrophy, right atrial enlargement, right axis deviation, increased amplitude of P wave in lead II in all groups.
It may show left ventricular hypertrophy in left heart disease.
